entities.name: Boc-(S)-4-chlorophenylalanine
observations: Reactant is decoded as Boc-protected (S)-2-amino-3-(4-chlorophenyl)propanoic acid.
Its carboxylic acid is converted to an amide in the product while Boc remains.

entities.name: Piperazine heteroarene amine
observations: Second reactant contains a secondary piperazine nitrogen that is the predicted nucleophile in the amide coupling.

entities.name: Boc amino acid amide coupling
observations: The amino-acid carboxyl group changes from C(=O)OH to C(=O)N(piperazine), forming a carboxamide.
The newly formed bond is between the acid carbonyl carbon and a piperazine nitrogen.
The proposed coupling systems are inferred: HATU/DIPEA, COMU/DIPEA, T3P/DIPEA, EDC·HCl with Oxyma or HOBt-type additive, or DIC/Oxyma.

entities.name: HCl Boc deprotection
observations: Closest ORD evidence concerns a downstream Boc deprotection of the preformed amide using HCl in dichloromethane/diethyl ether, giving a diammonium dihydrochloride salt in 91.2% yield.
This is not evidence for the forward coupling reagents.
